title: Trustworthiness in Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems: A Survey
reasoning: The paper focuses on a unified framework for trustworthiness in RAG systems across six dimensions: factuality, robustness, fairness, transparency, accountability, and privacy. While it mentions 'machine ethics' as a dimension of LLM trustworthiness in literature review and notes that models may learn shallow correlations involving religion, it does not include a specific evaluation or benchmarking component dedicated to religion, faith, or moral/ethical systems. Its fairness evaluation is specifically conducted on the 'Gender' demographic dimension.
